output.rationale: The requirement specifies IEEE C37.100 definitions for power switchgear, and the page header indicates it is for metal-clad switchgear. Among the candidates, 'CROWN-ARMV' is an engineered-to-order (ETO) product from the CROWN business unit that provides arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, compliant with IEEE standards including C37.20.7. This matches the requirement closely.
